acceptance: The dispatch step is gone or limited to a case the in-run post does not cover, with a workflow test pinning it; a verdict run produces no oracle-gate workflow run.
description: Since #3828 the verdict run evaluates and posts oracle-gate for the reviewed head in-run, but .github/workflows/oracle-verdict.yml (develop, step 'Dispatch the gate for the reviewed head', ~line 411) still dispatches oracle-gate.yml for that head. Every verdict run therefore triggers a second gate run, undercutting the run-count reduction that #3828/#3829 targeted (baseline 2,817 gate runs in 2026-10-24..26).
